about.lede:
Assorta is a notes and links app for Android, iPhone and iPad, free to install
      and free to use. The first 15 AI sorts are free, and filing keeps working after that.
      Assorta Pro is an optional subscription that lifts the AI sorting limit and adds AI
      Summary, billed by Apple or Google.

del.intro: This page explains how to delete your Assorta account and the data that goes with it, and what happens to anything that is kept. It applies to the Assorta app on Android and iOS.
del.meta.description: How to delete your Assorta account and data — the steps in the app, deletion by email, and what is deleted or kept.
del.meta.title: Delete your account — Assorta
del.s1.guest: Guest users have no account to delete. If you never signed in, removing the app removes everything you saved on that device — except a subscription bought without an account, which stays with RevenueCat under an anonymous identifier (see what is kept).
del.s1.list:
• Open Assorta and sign in, if you are not signed in already.
  • Go to Settings — the gear icon at the top of the main screen.
  • Scroll to Delete account at the bottom and tap it.
  • Read the confirmation dialog and tap Delete.
  • If you signed in a while ago, the app asks for your password (or for Google sign-in again) before it continues. This is a security check, so that a session left open on a lost phone cannot erase your account.
del.s1.p: This is the fastest route and it takes effect immediately.
del.s2.p1: If you have already removed the app, cannot sign in, or would simply rather we did it, email us at from the address your account uses, with the subject Delete my account.
del.s2.p2:
We use the sending address to identify the account, so please write from that address. We
      confirm by email once it is done, normally within 30 days of the request.
del.s3.callout:
Assorta stores your notes on each device rather than on our servers. Deleting your account
      removes them from the device you do it on. If you used Assorta on another phone or tablet,
      delete the notes there too, or remove the app from that device.
del.s3.list:
• Your account — email address, name and account identifier, held by Google Firebase, together with your password if you signed up with one.
  • Your purchase record — subscription status and purchase identifier, held by RevenueCat. A subscription bought without an account is the exception: it hangs on an anonymous installation identifier that no account owns, so the in-app deletion cannot reach it. Signing in before you delete asks RevenueCat to attach that purchase to your account, but an account can take over an anonymous purchase only once, so this does not always succeed. When it does not, the subscription stays under the anonymous identifier, and Settings → Assorta Pro → Upgrade → Restore in the app is what moves it to the account you are signed into.
  • Your notes and links stored on the device you delete the account from, along with the settings tied to your account on it.
del.s3.p:
Deletion is immediate and permanent. There is no grace period and no way for us to restore
      an account afterwards, so export anything you want to keep before you start.
del.s4.list:
• A purchase made without an account — the subscription status and purchase identifier of a subscription bought as a guest, held by RevenueCat under an anonymous installation identifier. No account owns it, so there is nothing we can look up on your behalf that points at it, and removing it would break your ability to restore a subscription you are still paying for. It carries no name, email address or payment details. To be rid of it, cancel the subscription in Google Play or the App Store — see Your subscription.
  • Diagnostics and usage analytics — crash reports and app-usage events collected through Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics. These are not deleted by the in-app flow. They are held by Google under Firebase's own retention windows and are not linked to the notes you saved. Email us if you want them removed as well.
  • Records we are required to keep — for example transaction records that tax or accounting law obliges us to retain. Apple and Google keep their own records of any purchase; we cannot delete those.
  • Anonymised or aggregated data that can no longer be connected to you.
del.s5.list:
• Android — Google Play app → profile picture → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Assorta → Cancel subscription.
  • iOS — Settings app → your name → Subscriptions → Assorta → Cancel subscription.
del.s5.p1: Deleting your account does not cancel a paid subscription. Assorta Pro is billed by Google Play or the App Store, not by us, and only you can cancel it. If you delete the account without cancelling, the store keeps charging you.
del.s5.p2: Cancel the subscription first, then delete the account.
del.s6.p1: You do not have to delete the account to delete what you saved. Any note can be removed on its own: open the group, tap the actions button on the note and choose Delete. Doing that for every note clears your content while the account stays.
del.s6.p2:
For anything you cannot remove yourself — diagnostics, for instance — email us and say which
      data you mean.
del.s7.p: Questions about deleting your account or your data: . Our Privacy Policy describes what we collect and why.
del.summary: In short: open Settings → Delete account in the app. Your account, your saved notes on that device, and the purchase record tied to that account are removed; a subscription bought without an account can stay behind, under an anonymous identifier. Deleting the account does not cancel a paid subscription — cancel that in Google Play or the App Store.

features.background.body: Switch away mid-save — the item still lands safely in its group. Nothing gets lost between apps.
features.background.title: Saves in the background
features.groups.body: AI picks the group the moment you save. Disagree? Change it with one tap — right from the confirmation.
features.groups.title: 30+ smart groups
features.h2: Built for the two seconds you're willing to spend
features.lede: Saving something should cost nothing. Finding it should cost even less.
features.looks.body:
Light and dark themes. Thirteen languages, from English and Ukrainian to Japanese,
          Korean and Arabic.
features.looks.title: Yours to look at
features.platforms.body:
Android and iOS — one app on every screen you use. Notes stay on the device you
          saved them on; syncing between devices isn’t there yet.
features.platforms.title: Everywhere you are
features.previews.body: Saved links keep their thumbnail and title — a YouTube frame, a product shot, an article cover — so you recognize them at a glance.
features.previews.title: Link previews
features.search.body:
One field over group names, a note's own text and a link's title - for the one save that did
          not land where you looked first.
features.search.title: Search when you need it
features.share.body: Assorta sits in the system share menu on Android and iOS. Two taps and it's saved — you never leave the app you're in.
features.share.title: Share-sheet saving
features.summary.body:
Tap AI Summary on a saved link and read the page in a few lines, without opening it. The summary
          is kept with the note, so the second look is instant and works offline. Included with Assorta Pro.
features.summary.title: AI Summary
footer.fine:
Third-party brand names, logos, links and preview images on this page are examples of the
      content you can save with Assorta - the kind of thing a person drops into the app - except
      for the App Store and Google Play badges, which link to the stores the app is
      published on. All of them remain the property of their owners. Assorta is an independent app:
      it is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of the brands shown, none of them
      are involved in it, and it never presents itself as any of them.
get.h2: Your future self will find it.
get.lede: Out now on Google Play and the App Store, free to install.
get.suggest: Have an idea for Assorta? Leave a suggestion and vote on what we build next →
groups.h2: A place for everything you'd ever save
groups.lede: These groups already exist the moment you install — no empty-notebook anxiety, no taxonomy homework.
hero.h1: Save everything. Find it in seconds.
hero.sub: Assorta is one fast inbox for links, notes and ideas. Drop anything in — AI files it into the right group, so you never dig through a graveyard of saves again.
how.h2: You add. AI organizes. You find.
how.lede: No folders to create, no tags to manage, no cleanup day. The sorting you always postpone is the part that happens on its own.
how.step1.body: Paste text, or share straight from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or your browser — Assorta lives in your share sheet.
how.step1.title: Drop it in
how.step2.body: Assorta reads what it is and puts it in the right group: Travel, Cooking, Wish list, Movies, Health — 30+ groups, zero setup.
how.step2.title: AI files it
how.step3.body:
One colorful dashboard with rich link previews. Open the group, and it's exactly where you'd
          expect it to be - or search your notes and groups when you want one exact save.
how.step3.title: Find it fast
how.step4.body:
Tap AI Summary on a saved link and the page comes back in a few lines, right there in the list.
          Included with Assorta Pro. When a page gives it nothing to work with, Assorta says so instead of
          inventing a summary.
how.step4.title: Remember why
